Cache Invalidation

Flush Redis cache entries for a user or expense book.

Invalidate User Cache

Clears all cached data for the given user (profile, books list, settings).

@if (userResult()) {
{{ userResult() }}
} @if (userError()) {
{{ userError() }}
}

Invalidate Book Cache

Clears all cached data for the given expense book (expenses, categories, budgets).

@if (bookResult()) {
{{ bookResult() }}
} @if (bookError()) {
{{ bookError() }}
}
Note: Cache entries expire automatically after 10 minutes. Use manual invalidation only when you need changes reflected immediately — e.g. after a manual DB fix or plan change.
